people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Yahweh of Armies says: “I am jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I am jealous for her with great wrath.”
translations.bsb: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “I am jealous for Zion with great zeal; I am jealous for her with great fervor.”
translations.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; I was jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I was jealous for her with great fury.
translations.asv: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: I am jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I am jealous for her with great wrath.
